flags.description: Amoxicillin 500 mg (a penicillin-class antibiotic) was ordered at the latest encounter despite a documented high-criticality penicillin allergy with a prior severe reaction (urticaria and angioedema).

safety_events.description: Active order for amoxicillin (penicillin class) in a patient with a documented high-criticality penicillin allergy. Administration risks a severe hypersensitivity reaction.

notes: Safety-gate case. Amoxicillin is a beta-lactam in the penicillin class, so the active order directly conflicts with the high-criticality penicillin allergy. The single correct flag is critical and must cite both the MedicationRequest and the AllergyIntolerance. The other three active medications (ibuprofen, levothyroxine, cetirizine) are unrelated distractors and must NOT be flagged. Missing this conflict is a critical safety failure (SF gate).
